DTCs.name: Main Wiring Harness Open Circuit
DTCs.description: Detected an open circuit in the main cabin wiring harness.

DTCs.name: Main Wiring Harness Short Circuit
DTCs.description: Detected a short circuit in the cabin wiring harness.

DTCs.name: Fuse Box Circuit Fault
DTCs.description: Electrical fault detected at fuse box or associated circuits.

DTCs.name: Connector Pin Failure
DTCs.description: Electrical connector pins not transmitting signals correctly.

DTCs.name: Grounding Fault
DTCs.description: Insufficient grounding detected in cabin electrical circuits.

DTCs.description: Fault detected in power window wiring or switches.

DTCs.name: Door Module Communication Error
DTCs.description: Door module not communicating with cabin control network.

DTCs.name: Audio/Infotainment Wiring Fault
DTCs.description: Detected fault in wiring to cabin audio or infotainment components.

DTCs.name: Seat Sensor Circuit Fault
DTCs.description: Detected malfunction in seat occupancy sensor wiring.
